en: Dependent on a wholesome state dissociated from the taints (*āsava*), a state that is neither associated with the taints nor wholesome arises by way of the root condition (*hetu-paccaya*). Under the root condition: one [formula] … pe … under non-disappearance: one.

Dependent on an unwholesome state associated with the taints, a state that is neither associated with the taints nor unwholesome arises by way of the root condition … Under the root condition: three … pe … under non-disappearance: three.

Conditioned by a neutral (*abyākata*) state dissociated from the taints, a state that is neither associated with the taints nor neutral arises by way of the root condition … Under the root condition: three … pe … under non-disappearance: three.
